topic: Tenses – Simple Present: Sentences and questions in the Simple Present
title: Simple Present: Statements and Questions

explanation.tr:
Simple Present; alışkanlıklar, rutinler ve genel gerçekler için kullanılır.
• Olumlu: I/you/we/they work. He/she/it works. (3. tekil şahısta -s/-es)
• Olumsuz: I don't work. She doesn't work. (doesn't sonrası -s yok)
• Soru: Do you work? Does he work?
• Soru kelimesiyle: Where do you live? What does she like?
• Kısa cevap: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
-es alanlar: go → goes, watch → watches, fix → fixes. y → ies: study → studies.
explanation.tk:
Simple Present endikler, gündelik işler we umumy hakykatlar üçin ulanylýar.
• Tassyklaýjy: I/you/we/they work. He/she/it works. (3-nji ýöňkemäniň birliginde -s/-es)
• Ýokluk: I don't work. She doesn't work. (doesn't-dan soň -s ýok)
• Sorag: Do you work? Does he work?
• Sorag sözi bilen: Where do you live? What does she like?
• Gysga jogap: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
-es alýanlar: go → goes, watch → watches, fix → fixes. y → ies: study → studies.
explanation.ru:
Simple Present используется для привычек, распорядка и общих фактов.
• Утверждение: I/you/we/they work. He/she/it works. (в 3-м лице ед. ч. -s/-es)
• Отрицание: I don't work. She doesn't work. (после doesn't нет -s)
• Вопрос: Do you work? Does he work?
• С вопросительным словом: Where do you live? What does she like?
• Краткий ответ: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
Окончание -es: go → goes, watch → watches, fix → fixes. y → ies: study → studies.

topic: Tenses – Simple Present: Signal words in the Simple Present
title: Signal Words for the Simple Present

explanation.tr:
Bazı kelimeler cümlenin Simple Present olması gerektiğini gösterir (signal words):
• Sıklık zarfları: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never
• every day / every week / every Monday
• on Mondays, at the weekend, in the morning
• once a week, twice a year
Sıklık zarfının yeri: ana fiilden önce, 'be' fiilinden sonra.
• She always gets up early.
• He is never late.
Zaman ifadeleri genellikle cümle sonunda: I visit my grandma every Sunday.
explanation.tk:
Käbir sözler sözlemiň Simple Present bolmalydygyny görkezýär (signal words):
• Ýygylyk hallary: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never
• every day / every week / every Monday
• on Mondays, at the weekend, in the morning
• once a week, twice a year
Ýygylyk halynyň orny: esasy işlikden öň, 'be' işliginden soň.
• She always gets up early.
• He is never late.
Wagt aňlatmalary köplenç sözlemiň ahyrynda: I visit my grandma every Sunday.
explanation.ru:
Некоторые слова-маркеры подсказывают, что нужен Simple Present (signal words):
• Наречия частоты: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never
• every day / every week / every Monday
• on Mondays, at the weekend, in the morning
• once a week, twice a year
Место наречия частоты: перед смысловым глаголом, после 'be'.
• She always gets up early.
• He is never late.
Выражения времени обычно в конце: I visit my grandma every Sunday.

topic: Tenses – Simple Past: Positive statements in the Simple Past
title: Simple Past: Positive Statements

explanation.tr:
Simple Past, geçmişte başlayıp bitmiş eylemler için kullanılır.
• Düzenli fiiller: fiil + -ed → work → worked, play → played
  - e ile biten: live → lived
  - ünsüz + y: study → studied
  - kısa ünlü + tek ünsüz: stop → stopped
• Düzensiz fiiller ezberlenir: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, have → had, buy → bought
• Tüm öznelerle aynı biçim: I/he/they worked.
• be: I/he/she/it was, you/we/they were
explanation.tk:
Simple Past geçmişde başlap gutaran hereketler üçin ulanylýar.
• Dogry işlikler: işlik + -ed → work → worked, play → played
  - e bilen gutarýan: live → lived
  - çekimsiz + y: study → studied
  - gysga çekimli + bir çekimsiz: stop → stopped
• Nädogry işlikler ýatlanýar: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, have → had, buy → bought
• Ähli eýeler bilen birmeňzeş görnüş: I/he/they worked.
• be: I/he/she/it was, you/we/they were
explanation.ru:
Simple Past используется для действий, которые начались и закончились в прошлом.
• Правильные глаголы: глагол + -ed → work → worked, play → played
  - на -e: live → lived
  - согласная + y: study → studied
  - краткая гласная + одна согласная: stop → stopped
• Неправильные глаголы нужно выучить: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, have → had, buy → bought
• Форма одинакова для всех лиц: I/he/they worked.
• be: I/he/she/it was, you/we/they were

topic: Tenses – Simple Past: Questions and short answers in the Simple Past
title: Simple Past: Questions and Short Answers

explanation.tr:
Simple Past'ta soru 'did' ile yapılır; fiil yalın hâle döner.
• Did + özne + yalın fiil? → Did you see the match?
• Kısa cevaplar: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
• 'be' fiili ile did kullanılmaz: Was she at home? – Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't. Were they late? – Yes, they were.
Dikkat: Did you went? (✗) → Did you go? (✓)
explanation.tk:
Simple Past-da sorag 'did' bilen düzülýär; işlik esasy görnüşe dolanýar.
• Did + eýe + esasy işlik? → Did you see the match?
• Gysga jogaplar: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
• 'be' işligi bilen did ulanylmaýar: Was she at home? – Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't. Were they late? – Yes, they were.
Üns beriň: Did you went? (✗) → Did you go? (✓)
explanation.ru:
Вопросы в Simple Past строятся с 'did'; глагол возвращается в начальную форму.
• Did + подлежащее + глагол? → Did you see the match?
• Краткие ответы: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
• С глаголом 'be' did не нужен: Was she at home? – Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't. Were they late? – Yes, they were.
Внимание: Did you went? (✗) → Did you go? (✓)

topic: Tenses – Simple Past: Questions in the Simple Past
title: Making Questions in the Simple Past

explanation.tr:
Bir olumlu cümleyi Simple Past soruya çevirmek için:
1. Cümlenin başına Did koy.
2. Fiili yalın hâle getir.
• She cooked dinner. → Did she cook dinner?
• They saw a whale. → Did they see a whale?
• 'be' ile özne ve fiilin yeri değişir:
  He was angry. → Was he angry?
  You were there. → Were you there?
• 'can' → could: She could swim. → Could she swim?
explanation.tk:
Tassyklaýjy sözlemi Simple Past soragyna öwürmek üçin:
1. Sözlemiň başyna Did goý.
2. Işligi esasy görnüşe getir.
• She cooked dinner. → Did she cook dinner?
• They saw a whale. → Did they see a whale?
• 'be' bilen eýe we işligiň orny çalyşýar:
  He was angry. → Was he angry?
  You were there. → Were you there?
• 'can' → could: She could swim. → Could she swim?
explanation.ru:
Чтобы превратить утверждение в вопрос в Simple Past:
1. Поставь Did в начало.
2. Верни глагол в начальную форму.
• She cooked dinner. → Did she cook dinner?
• They saw a whale. → Did they see a whale?
• С 'be' подлежащее и глагол меняются местами:
  He was angry. → Was he angry?
  You were there. → Were you there?
• 'can' → could: She could swim. → Could she swim?
